scope: Haiti medical discovery — Université d'État d'Haïti Faculty of Medicine and Pharmacy

verifiedFacts.claim: Université d'État d'Haïti identifies the Faculty of Medicine and Pharmacy as one of its faculties and dates its creation to 1861.

UEH's official 2025/26 admission notice includes the Faculty of Medicine and Pharmacy among the faculties covered by its admission competition and lists the documents required after a candidate passes the competition.
An official UEH admissions entity page describes annual competitive recruitment at the faculty and lists medicine, pharmacy, medical biology and optometry among its routes.

holdReasons: No complete, current fee schedule or mandatory-charge schedule was located for a medicine applicant.
No current faculty-specific admissions notice establishes programme duration, full academic eligibility, selection criteria, intake, or an international-applicant route.

Teaching language, curriculum, named and current clinical partners, professional recognition, accommodation, financial support and student-support provision were not verified from authoritative current sources.

Recent independent reporting indicates disruption to a key public clinical-training setting; current, named clinical-placement continuity must be verified directly before any public clinical-training claim is published.
nextAction: Obtain a current FMP admissions and fee notice plus direct confirmation of the teaching language, programme structure, clinical sites and student support before considering a payload.
